notes: Phase 1.6 (report check) is defined to run before the EIC but its table only has meaning if reports are edited afterwards; I presented reports as drafted plus the change table, which is a judgment call. The skill asks the EIC to 'read the reports first, then the paper briefly', but the same context had already read the paper in Phase 0, so independence of the EIC read is weaker than described. The `benchmarks` subcommand of related_search.py returned an empty list for this paper (math benchmarks not recognised), so the baseline scout table could not be built; the skill does not say what to do in that case. strict mode labels May-June 2025 preprints as 'recent preprint' relative to a 2025-09-24 cutoff, which makes the closest neighbours (ALP, Su & Cardie) non-binding; this is by design but means the literature check rarely produces required comparisons for fast-moving topics. `verify` only confirms a title exists, yet Domain reviewer rules require describing content from the abstract; I marked content descriptions of two verified titles [verify]. Environment note: the Bash sandbox blocked commands containing shell variables or $?, so paths had to be written out in full. Pool-position bands vs Overall: the rubric says Overall 4 needs pool >= 65, leaving little room for R3-type reviewers at 55-64; I used 66 for R3 to stay consistent.
